notes: Encodes cleanly using the charge_cast idiom established by Wand of Magic Missiles. Three charges, fixed cost of 1 per cast at L9, no recharge (resetCadence: never). Destruction policy permanent_on_empty approximates 'becomes nonmagical' — the semantic distinction (nonmagical vs destroyed/cracked) is not representable in the current ItemDestructionPolicy enum but permanent_on_empty is the honest best-fit. Wish's own mechanics (DM agenda, reshape reality) are out of scope; the ring merely grants access to the spell by spellId.
